summary: Completed comprehensive testing of VHC Talent OS recruitment portal. Backend APIs mostly functional with one critical fix applied. Frontend has role-based routing bug affecting user experience.

critical_bugs.issue: JobResponse model had required company_id field causing 520 errors when company_id was null
critical_bugs.impact: Blocked job browsing, creation, and application flows
critical_bugs.status: FIXED - Changed company_id to Optional[str] in JobResponse model

integration_issues.issue: All users redirected to candidate dashboard regardless of selected role
integration_issues.details: Employer registration successful but user redirected to /candidate instead of /employer

passed_tests: Admin dashboard loads with correct stats cards
Admin navigation (Users, Jobs, Candidates, Companies pages)
User registration for all roles (candidate, employer, recruiter)
Job browsing UI shows available jobs with Apply buttons
Frontend loads correctly with VHC branding and lime green theme
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix role-based routing bug in authentication flow. Users are being redirected to candidate dashboard regardless of their selected role during registration. Check AuthProvider and routing logic in App.js.
